lines.text: Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the family heads assigned land by lot to nine and a half tribes, since Moses had given the other two and a half tribes land east of the Jordan.
Caleb approached Joshua at Gilgal and said he was forty years old when Moses sent him from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land.
Caleb said he remained loyal to the LORD, and Moses swore him the land he walked on, and now he was ninety years old.
Caleb said he was still strong, and he asked for the hill country where the Anakim had great and fortified cities.
Joshua blessed Caleb and gave him Hebron, which used to be called Kiriath-arba, after Arba, the greatest man among the Philistines.
